ns2:section.sectionText: Applied Psychological Assessment In this seminar, students will be provided with experience in applied psychological assessment including formal psychological testing with children, adolescents, and young adults. Readings, observations, discussions, and case reviews will focus on conceptual, practical, and ethical issues inherent in assessment including the interpretation and presentation of results. Flexible and interactive approaches to contextualized evaluation will be emphasized, including non-traditional, and virtual methods. Seminars will be conducted via ZOOM, or in person at the Illinois NeuroBehavioral Assessment Laboratory (INBAL) located at 301 N. Neil St., Suite 210, in downtown Champaign. All in person meetings will be in accordance with CDC Social Distancing Guidelines. Please contact instructor for more details.
